_comment: Hornero plugin hooks. Session lifecycle only — guardrail hooks (validate-skill, catalog-regen, smoke-check) live in templates/settings.json because they reference Hornero scripts that require a path your installation knows about. Add those to your own .claude/settings.json if you want them; this file stays self-contained so the plugin loads cleanly from any host. The Stop hook automatically runs the extract-lesson skill at session end via hooks/auto-extract-lesson.sh — to opt out for a session, set HORNERO_NO_AUTO_EXTRACT=1 before launching Claude Code.

hooks.command: echo '↪ Hornero here. Tell me what you'\''re working on and I'\''ll find the right lens. (/hornero:kickoff for a guided start, /hornero:catalog for the full set.)'
